# Maki

> Get it wrapped up with Maki: a calm daily planner that brings tasks, projects, and calendar events into one realistic plan.

Maki helps people decide what matters, make time for it, and get it done. It combines task capture, project boards, daily planning, calendar-aware scheduling, and a focused work timer in a single web application.

## Product

- [Maki](https://www.makiroll.xyz/): Start planning with Maki.
- Category: Productivity and daily planning web application.
- Key capabilities: tasks, projects, calendar synchronization, timeboxing, focus sessions, and local workspace preview.
- Pricing: Free to start; no card required.

## Positioning

Maki is for people who want a realistic daily plan instead of a longer task list. Its purpose is to show tasks beside real calendar commitments and help shape a day that fits the available time.
